In brief: the recommendation is **conditional, not yes/no** — don't build a full public self-serve free tier yet (you have no self-serve signup/onboarding infrastructure and no conversion data, and Finance confirmed free-tier costs scale with active users regardless of payment). Instead, run a bounded, sales-assisted, capped, time-boxed pilot (6–12 months) with pre-committed numeric success/kill criteria, then decide on a full build from measured data. Confidence: **MEDIUM** — the breakeven conversion rate (0.45%–6%, central ~1.6%, given $10K ACV) is a real, computable threshold, but every input to it (free-tier cost per user, engineering build cost, signup volume, and expected conversion itself) is currently a bracketed guess rather than measured fact.
